newsitem.title: CHINA: China prepares for Spring Festival migration.
newsitem.headline: China prepares for Spring Festival migration.

text.p: China has ordered officials at all levels to prepare for the tide of humanity expected to hit the nation's overloaded transport system during the Spring Festival season next February, the Legal Daily said on Thursday.
Vice Premier Wu Bangguo told a teleconference that mechanisms should be introduced to ease the annual strain of tens of millions of workers heading home for the traditional lunar new year festival.
Officials at all levels should put the task at the top of their work agenda, Wu said.
Trains, buses and planes are routinely packed during the festival season, while thousands of hopeful travellers camp out at railway stations or pay large sums for black-market tickets.

Next year's Spring Festival season, which will stretch from February 7 to 21, could see even more travellers than usual because of floods this year that forced some farmers off the land and into cities in search of work, Wu said.
Comprehensive measures should be adopted, including developing industries near farmers' homes to attract the surplus work force, he said.
"This is the fundamental way to solve the problem," he told the teleconference.
